note: Behavioural question bank. Order follows a realistic interview arc: intro → role/function motivation → company → (optional) industry → competency evidence → self-awareness. Every question carries a 'focus_family' (introduction | motivation | competency | challenge | achievement) — authored, never inferred — which the Focused Session uses to pick exactly one balanced question per family. Full Session ignores focus_family entirely and is unchanged. 'role_motivation' is role-aware — its wording is filled from the target role/function at session start (deterministic templates, never a runtime model call); its stable id/type never changes. 'why_this_company' fills {{company}} from the parsed JD / readiness target (falls back to 'this company'). 'industry_motivation' is conditional (dynamic + "conditional": "industry"): it is only asked when a distinct industry is known and is not redundant with the role family or company; otherwise it is dropped at generation time. Competencies align with the tags in seed_answer_bank.json so RAG retrieval matches the user's own prepared answers.
